name: cortex
description: Relative Cortex orchestration for reliable staged agent work with durable internal audit state.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate staged work across Codex agents
interface.longDescription: Adds 21 bundled agent profiles, 10 skills, three coordinator lifecycle operations, and scoped worker question/report transport over the local Cortex v7 ledger. Cortex preserves the exact user-authored request, blocks coordinator intent expansion, requires durable clarification for underspecified product work, and keeps receipt-backed gates, verification, maintenance, and handoff state.
interface.defaultPrompt: Coordinate this task with Cortex. Use help, harvest, harvest-refresh, or prune when that exact route is requested.
